Indian Army Dental Corps Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS) will release the notification for the post of Dental Corps on the official website of Indian Army. This recruitment has been issued for 37 posts. Online applying process for Indian Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026 will start from 22 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 22 October 2026. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 200/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Important Links

  • Official Website

Indian Army Dental Corps Online Form 2026 is a government exam notification. All details including dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.
